delta.reading: Every Travis conformant atom is written once (873766 written = 873766 landing atoms). Distinct prop_ids and unique snapshots are 500307. The extra 373459 writes are second-or-later atoms that share a prop_id and therefore the same place_key.

writePath.pages: pagePropIds is a stride slice of that list, default 8000, no overlap
writePath.cliCadRows: all atoms whose sourceIdentifiers.prop_id is in the page
writePath.parcelNodeId: body.nodeId only when it contains ':'; Factory minted nid_ does not, so the key is always ${county}:${prop_id}. Tested: flat nid_ body for 493738 -> 48453:493738.
writePath.upsert: INSERT place_layer_snapshots ON CONFLICT (adapter_key, place_key) DO UPDATE. Last atom body for that prop_id wins.
writePath.txgioMultiFeatureDoesNotAddWrites: joinParcelRows keeps the first txgio_parcel feature per prop_id and counts the rest as txgioMultiFeature. That is a join choice, not an extra snapshot write.

mechanism.believe: Multiple cad-parcel-roll atoms share one prop_id (documented pattern: two tax years; adapter fetchRef and citation locator are county:prop_id:taxYear; Hays gold 48209:135570 was read in CP1 as two atoms, tax year 2025 plus a second row). The bake collapses those atoms onto one parcel node id county:prop_id, then counts each atom as written. Factory resolve binds the same aliasKey countyFips:prop_id and MERGED_INTO extras; it does not emit one snapshot per nid_.
mechanism.secondMechanismSameObservation: Overlapping bake pages, or a prop_id joining more than one parcel node, would also make written larger than a DISTINCT-prop_id or unique-place_key count.
mechanism.whyRejectedOverlappingPages: pagePropIds is a disjoint stride over a DISTINCT list. Overlapping pages would write some atoms more than once, so written would exceed the landing atom census. written equals landing_verified 48453 (873766 = 873766). That equality is the second derivation. Overlapping pages are rejected.
mechanism.whyRejectedPropIdJoinsMoreThanOneNode: That was the 2026-08-28 session's accepted mechanism. It is rejected. parcelNodeIdFromBody drops nid_ and keys by county:prop_id, so one prop_id cannot produce two place_keys. Factory aliasKey is the same county:prop_id. The live snapshot census under node:48453: is 500307, equal to DISTINCT prop_ids, not 873766. If one prop_id wrote more than one node, the snapshot table would hold the larger number.

verdict.store: one place_layer_snapshots row per Travis parcel node (node:48453:<prop_id>). 500307 unique keys. Not overlapping pages. Not 873766 distinct nodes.
verdict.writtenField: a process counter of atom-row upserts, including ON CONFLICT updates of the same key. It is not a snapshot census. Card F close expected written = conformantCadRows; those fields are different units on Travis.
verdict.lastWins: When two atoms share a prop_id, the later page-loop body overwrites the snapshot. That is a tax-year selection gap already on the property STATE backlog (two-tax-year selection at bake). It is not store duplication and it is not a reason to start a Travis-only bake or P-80 from this recon.
